data.one_liner: Minimal and type-safe web framework for Dart inspired by Express and Hono.
data.what_it_does: Darto is a microframework for building web applications and APIs in Dart. It handles routing, middleware pipelines, requests, responses, context management, and server listening.
use_when: You want to build lightweight web servers or REST APIs in Dart.
You prefer an Express- or Hono-style API for handling routes and middleware.
avoid_when: You are building a client-side Flutter application.
You need HTTP/2 support since Darto serves over HTTP/1.1 only.
strengths: Familiar Express/Hono-inspired routing and context API.
Includes features like content negotiation, routing groups, and middleware support.

alternatives.name: shelf_router
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative routing package for Dart backend applications using the Shelf ecosystem.
